description_en: Queries whiteboard application information under a cloud account by using paged query. Paging is supported
description_zh: 分页查询云账号下的白板应用信息
name: DescribeApps

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. If this parameter is left empty, all application IDs are queried by default. To obtain the AppID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).
parameters.description_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符，参数为空默认查询所有应用ID。获取AppID，请参见[CreateApp](~~204234~~)。
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. If this parameter is left empty, all application IDs are queried by default. To obtain the AppID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符，参数为空默认查询所有应用ID。获取AppID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en:
The status of the whiteboard application. If this parameter is left empty, all statuses are queried by default. Valid values:

- **1**: Enabled.
- **2**: Disabled.
parameters.description_zh:
白板应用状态，参数为空默认查询所有状态。取值：

- **1**：启用。
- **2**：停用。
parameters.help_en:
The status of the whiteboard application. If this parameter is left empty, all statuses are queried by default. Valid values:

- **1**: Enabled.
- **2**: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
白板应用状态，参数为空默认查询所有状态。取值：

- **1**：启用。
- **2**：停用
parameters.name: app_status

parameters.description_en: The page number. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default.
parameters.description_zh: 查询页码，参数为空默认查询第1页。
parameters.help_en: The page number. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，参数为空默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10.
parameters.description_zh: 每页显示个数，参数为空默认显示个数为10。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，参数为空默认显示个数为10
